title: frasera diluta
intro: Frasera diluta, commonly known as Bear Root or Squaw Root, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. Native to the northwestern United States and southwestern Canada, it has been traditionally used by the indigenous people to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Frasera diluta include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anti-oxidation, and cardiovascular protection.
